title: Meet Athena — the AI agent that runs your commerce | Shoplazza
excerpt: Stop operating tools. Tell Athena the outcome; it coordinates every specialist agent and brings the work back for you to approve.
content_html:
SHOPLAZZA
AgentsSolutionsResourcesPricingAbout

Athena runs your commerce. You run the business.

The AI agent that builds your store, runs ads, and keeps working after you launch.

Tell Athena what you want

Watch Athena take one instruction and run with it.

You type the goal. Athena builds the store, makes the images, launches the ads — you just approve.

See Athena in action.

Watch Athena work.

One Athena. Every commerce capability.

You talk to one agent. Athena reads the goal, splits the work, and calls the right specialist — then brings the finished work back to approve.

  • AI Store Builder — designs pages, writes the copy, and fixes technical SEO, no theme to wrestle with.
  • LazzaStudio — turns a plain photo into on-brand product imagery, the same look across every page.
  • AdValet (Ares) — tests creatives, kills the losers, and pours budget into winners, within the cap you set.
  • Shoplazza Payments — retries declined charges and recovers orders you'd otherwise lose.
  • Loyalty & Push — times the offer, wins back the lapsed, and grows repeat revenue.
  • Fulfillment by Shoplazza — routes, tracks, and ships, so shipping isn't your problem anymore.

What Athena did overnight.

You slept eight hours. Athena didn't. Here's what it got done before you opened the conversation.

  • 3:08 AM — Store Building Agent: fixed 3 technical SEO issues.
  • 3:40 AM — Fulfillment Agent: shipped 142 overnight orders.
  • 6:00 AM — Ads Agent: tested 3 creatives, CPA $18.40 → $12.20.
  • 7:00 AM — Payments Agent: recovered $2,400 from 23 declined orders.
  • 8:15 AM — Loyalty Agent: queued a win-back to 310 lapsed buyers.

From operator to decision-maker.

Going live is the easy part. The years after decide everything — and that's the part Athena takes off your plate.

Other platforms give you tools. Athena gets the work done.

Every other store gives you software to operate. Shoplazza AI gives you a master agent that operates the store for you. That's the whole difference.

Merchants who made the shift.

Here's what happens when AI agents run the operations.

Questions, answered.

Everything you need to know before you hand the work to Athena.

Do I still control my store, or does the AI run everything?

You stay in control. Athena does the work; you make the calls — nothing ships, scales, or spends without your approval. You move from operating the store hour by hour to reviewing Athena's work in minutes.

How much time does Athena actually save?

Merchants go from running tools 4–6 hours a day to reviewing Athena's work in about 8 minutes a day. The operating work happens overnight; you read one morning briefing and approve.

Do I need technical or design skills to use Shoplazza AI?

No. You describe what you want in plain language, and Athena coordinates the specialist agents to build it. There's nothing to code, design, or wire up yourself.

How do I get started?

Tell Athena what you want to sell, and it builds your store from the very first conversation. Starting is free, no credit card required.

Athena is ready.

Tell it the outcome you want. It handles the rest.

Get started

Used by merchants worldwide — store, ads, payments, retention & fulfillment in one agent.
